```yaml
name: Merge dev into master

on:
  push:
    branches:
      - dev
  pull_request:
    branches:
      - main
    types: [opened, synchronize, reopened]

permissions:
  contents: write
  pull-requests: write

jobs:
  merge-check:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0

      - name: Set up Python
        uses: actions/setup-python@v5
        with:
          python-version: '3.9'

      - name: Install uv
        run: |
          curl -LsSf https://astral.sh/uv/install.sh | sh
          echo "$HOME/.cargo/bin" >> $GITHUB_PATH

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: |
          uv venv .venv
          source .venv/bin/activate
          uv pip install --upgrade pip
          uv pip install pytest opencv-python numpy
          uv pip install -e .

      - name: Run tests
        run: |
          source .venv/bin/activate
          python -m pytest tests/

      - name: Run Ruff checks
        run: |
          source .venv/bin/activate
          uv run ruff check bbox_visualizer tests examples

      - name: Run Ruff format check
        run: |
          source .venv/bin/activate
          uv run ruff format --check bbox_visualizer tests examples

      - name: Generate documentation
        run: |
          source .venv/bin/activate
          uv run mkdocs build

      - name: Check for changes in documentation
        id: check_docs
        run: |
          git diff --exit-code docs/ || echo "docs_changed=true" >> $GITHUB_ENV

      - name: Update documentation with MkDocs Material
        if: env.docs_changed == 'true'
        run: |
          source .venv/bin/activate
          uv run mkdocs build

      - name: Create Pull Request if needed
        if: github.event_name == 'push' && github.ref == 'refs/heads/dev'
        uses: peter-evans/create-pull-request@v5
        with:
          commit-message: "chore: merge dev into main"
          title: "chore: merge dev into main"
          body: |
            Automatically merging dev branch into main.
            
            This PR was automatically created to merge changes from dev into main.
          branch: merge-dev-into-main
          base: main
          delete-branch: true
          token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}

      - name: Merge PR if all checks pass
        if: github.event_name == 'pull_request' && github.base_ref == 'main'
        run: |
          gh pr merge --auto --squash "$PR_URL"
        env:
          GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
          PR_URL: ${{ github.event.pull_request.html_url }}
```
